The import's Package.swift names v1.20.0. A fresh comparison against the
upstream tag on 2026-10-23 matched every retained source/plugin/license file
except Package.swift and the two warning fixes described below. History did
not record the original download archive checksum or import command; those
historical details remain unresolved. The upstream commit is established by
the current tag plus the retained-file comparison, not an invented import log.

Local differences from that upstream commit:
- Package.swift is reduced to the macOS SwiftTerm library, build-info generator
  and plugin, Swift 5 mode; upstream benchmark/test/example/platform-specific
  targets and dependencies are omitted. Minimum macOS is 13.
- Sources/SwiftTerm/Apple/Metal/Shaders.metal is omitted and the shader resource
  is not declared; CoreText rendering supports Command Line Tools-only builds.
- Nonshipping upstream apps, tests, benchmarks, docs and supporting root files
  are omitted. Sources/SwiftTerm (except Shaders.metal), the build-info generator,
  Plugins and LICENSE otherwise match upstream, subject to the warning fix.
- Porpoise d494c68731bbb64f12cc6e993e1a3efe9f37639b adds `_ =` to two
  vertices.withUnsafeBytes calls in Apple/Metal/MetalTerminalRenderer.swift.
